sections.Profile:
"Warlok," released by Williams in October 1982, is a solid-state pinball machine with a medieval fantasy theme. It features two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball, making it a straightforward but challenging game. Designed by Mike Kubin with artwork by Seamus McLaughlin, only 412 units were produced.
